name: Payroll Calculation Peak Load
stimulus: HR triggers payroll calculation for 10,000 employees, including overtime and deductions
response: Payroll calculation completes within 10 minutes and remains responsive for HR users (p95 UI actions < 800ms)

name: Sensitive Data Access Audit
stimulus: Auditor requests evidence of access controls and logs for employee personal data (salary, address, performance reviews)
response: All access is authenticated and authorized by role; audit logs are tamper-evident and retained for 12 months

name: Onboarding Workflow Change
stimulus: Company introduces a new onboarding step: equipment approval by department manager with SLA tracking
response: Workflow change is implemented and deployed within 2 days without breaking existing onboarding cases

name: HR System Integration Import
stimulus: System imports employee updates from external identity provider and time-tracking system (CSV/API), including corrections
response: Imports complete reliably, conflicts are detected and reported, and data is consistent within 30 minutes

name: High Availability During Review Season
stimulus: Managers and employees concurrently access performance review forms while a node crashes
response: Service remains available with failover; no data loss; user sessions recover within 60 seconds
